devicesHelp: One row per tablet. Object ID: letters, digits, _ and -. REST tablets need host and port, MQTT tablets the topic ID (FreeKiosk's device name in lowercase, spaces as _).
Name: Name
restApiKeyHelp: The key set in FreeKiosk under Settings → Advanced → REST API. Leave empty if none is set.
mqttHint: Enter this ioBroker host, the port, user and password in FreeKiosk under Settings → Advanced → MQTT. The broker runs only while at least one MQTT tablet is configured. Do not expose the port to the internet: the connection is not encrypted.
idError: 1-32 characters A-Z, a-z, 0-9, _ or -, not info
hostError: Hostname or IP address, without http://, path or %
